source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 8 decembrie — «Sfântul Ierarh Sofronie, Episcopul Ciprului»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 8ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Όσιος Σωφρόνιος επίσκοπος Κύπρου»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 8 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps, and the entry is the same man: the Cypriot of devout Christian parents who was chosen for the see after the death of the bishop Damianos. The day's line calls him «επίσκοπος Κύπρου» while the text says he became «Αρχιεπίσκοπος Κύπρου»; the folder's existing office, Bishop of Cyprus, is left as it stands and the page's own second word is recorded here rather than written into the field. It gives no year, so the folder's dateless state stands. No hymn is printed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (25 September 2026).
